extracted.intended_audience: general readers and researchers interested in satirical news websites and online media
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic profile of a single satirical news website (The Hard Times), describing its editorial focus, history, content verticals, distribution, and audience metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial focus: punk, alt music, and millennial culture
rubrics_metrics.description: “The Hard Times is a satirical website with a focus on punk (especially hardcore punk and first wave screamo), alt music, and millennial culture.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site's subject-matter lens is a defining editorial criterion: content should center on punk/alt-music scenes and millennial cultural touchpoints, targeting readers who identify with or care about those niches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specificity and niche appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: “It has received praise for its specificity and niche appeal.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being specific to a well-defined niche is presented as a strength — effective satire from this outlet is characterized by detailed, niche-targeted references rather than broad/general parody.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylistic comparison to established satire outlets
rubrics_metrics.description: “It has been compared to The Onion, ClickHole, and Reductress in style.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stylistic benchmark: adopt conventions and tone comparable to major satirical outlets (headline-driven parody, faux-news framing, deadpan delivery) as part of the site's recognizable voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiplatform/content-vertical strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: “The Hard Times also publishes Hard Drive, a satirical video game vertical, hosts stand-up comedy shows at music festivals, and produces podcasts.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A successful approach includes diversifying into sub-verticals (e.g., Hard Drive), podcasts, video, and live events to extend brand reach and serve adjacent niche audiences; examples of the podcasts and video staffing are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social-media-driven virality/distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: “Content published by The Hard Times is typically virally spread through engagement on social media such as Facebook.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribution and audience growth rely on shareability and social engagement; optimizing content for platforms like Facebook is implied as an operational and editorial consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience/traffic as a success metric
rubrics_metrics.description: “The site averages between 2 and 6 million views a month.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monthly pageviews are presented as a quantitative measure of reach and impact; traffic metrics are relevant indicators of the site's success and virality.
